title: Portfolio Editor App
description: A custom local web app to manage and publish this portfolio's content.
details: Re-architected the portfolio site to load dynamically from JSON files, and built a custom local React/Node.js editor to manage them. The editor features a one-click publish integration that computes Git diffs and pushes changes seamlessly to the live site.

title: Data Validation Assistant
description: Validate and identify issues with data.
details: An interoperable automated data validation tool that analyzes datasets against a 6-pillar framework to assist the data validation process.

title: Digital brain
description: Manage AI using a brain-like graph rather than prompts.
details:
Applying the idea of using a personal knowledge graph (PKG) to drive and monitor agentic processes and workflows.

Current nodes of my PKG: 287 (+1 since 1 day ago, +4 since 1 week ago)

title: Statistical Metadata Assistant
description: Automate the generation of statistical metadata.
details: Takes available information about a survey (e.g. survey questions, etc.) and produces necessary statistical metadata (e.g. DDI).

title: Virtual Tutor
details: An AI tutoring assistant that syncs with the user's active screen to provide real-time, context-aware instructions and tailored learning guidance based on active workspace state.

title: Real Estate Empire
description: Ottawa real estate strategy game concept.
details: A simulation game mapped onto high-fidelity satellite imagery of Ottawa. Choose a backstory, scout listings in real neighborhoods (The Glebe, Kanata), manage cash flow, and outbid AI competitors.

title: DB Early Retirement Calculator
description: Determine FIRE date and compare your income and expenses with Canadians.
details: An early retirement calculator tailored for individuals with a Defined Benefit pension plan, mapping out the portfolio and pension timeline to find your retirement age.

title: Gmail Cleaner CLI
details: A command-line tool to clean, organize, and label emails in your Gmail inbox using IMAP. Built with Python and Rich for a polished terminal experience.

title: Drug Utilization Dashboard
description: Monitor drug utilization data at the Canada-level. (*experimental*)
details: An interactive dashboard and data pipeline monitoring utilization of drugs of concern in Canada using simulated public claims and private proxy volumes.

title: NIHB Policy Assistant
details: An experimental AI query engine designed to provide source-cited policy answers about the Non-Insured Health Benefits program.

title: Canadian AI Jobs Report
description: Monitor what post-secondary fields will do well in an AI age. (*experimental*)
details: An interactive dashboard analyzing the economic value of Canadian college majors. Maps CIP programs to NOC occupations, displaying median salaries, 10-year job growth, competition metrics, and AI disruption risk.

title: WFA Policy Advisor
details: An interactive Canadian Federal Public Service WFA (Work Force Adjustment) advisor chatbot. Navigates complex Treasury Board guidelines, opting periods, and voluntary departures with strict documentation groundings.

title: Ottawa Recreation Discovery
description: Find Ottawa recreation centres near you.
details: A visual discovery tool and interactive map for parents to find municipal recreation facilities and summer camps in Ottawa by proximity, amenities, and geographical sectors.

title: Modular Survey Tools
details: An extensible, open-source survey builder optimized for mobile devices to collect data through survey questions and sensors. Adheres to DDI lifecycle standard.

title: Bookkeeping App
details: A fully offline desktop bookkeeping app for Canadian sole proprietors. Ingests credit card statement CSVs, matches receipts via local OCR (Tesseract), and auto-classifies expenses to CRA Form T2125 lines while calculating GST/HST ITCs.

title: Ottawa Global Benchmark Engine
details: A comparative analytics dashboard comparing Ottawa with global peer cities (Austin, Adelaide, Helsinki) across labour, housing, and tech-sector benchmarks. Uses Python to extract data from Statistics Canada's CODR API via an MCP server, FRED, ABS, and Statistics Finland, with a DuckDB-Wasm backend in the browser for fast, on-the-fly index baseline and divergence trend analysis.

title: Debate Game
details: A mobile-first debate facilitator for kids. Two named teams take turns arguing a randomly drawn topic.

title: n-1
description: Fun anagram word game with a twist.
details: A mobile-first word game (PWA) where players find all the shorter words hidden inside a 7-letter starter word by removing one letter at a time. Progress through 4 levels of increasing word length, racing against a 2-minute timer. Find the hidden bonus word to earn extra hints. Daily leaderboard included.

title: WordString
description: A cozy word puzzle with a sewing twist.
details: A mobile-first, offline-first word game (PWA) wrapped in a warm sewing-and-yarn aesthetic. Spell words horizontally from the last letter of a vertical starter word using a pool of colorful thread-spool tiles. Race the clock, earn time bonuses for longer words, and trigger playful mascot celebrations. Daily leaderboard included.
